article.body:
AuraLuxMuse: No Evidence of Operational Stage-Lighting Capability

The arXiv cs.AI record, "AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance," dated 8 October 2026, lists a paper proposal but does not demonstrate a built, tested or operational stage-lighting system. No specific institution, service, or procurement body is identified as affected.
